review_notes: Read the whole file and checked related definitions in MapComap.lean (swapLeft, prodMkLeft, prodMkRight and their lemmas). The only substantial repeated machinery is the Fubini/swap proof in comap_prod_swap and map_prod_swap. The prod_const_comp and const_prod_comp pair is similar but differs in substance, so I did not report it. I could not compile anything. The proposed proof of comap_prod_swap is a sketch that relies on definitional unfolding (swapLeft is defined as comap with Prod.swap), and the rw/rfl steps may need small adjustments. comap_prod_swap has no other uses in the repository, so rewriting it is safe. The IsSFiniteKernel instances for prodMkLeft and prodMkRight are assumed to exist, as they are already needed by the current statement.

findings.problem: comap_prod_swap and map_prod_swap use the same proof. Both reduce to function integrals with ext_fun_iff, expand both sides with lintegral_map and lintegral_prod, discharge a measurability side goal with `swap; · fun_prop`, and close with `(lintegral_lintegral_swap ?_).symm; fun_prop`. comap_prod_swap adds only a few simp lemmas for prodMkLeft/prodMkRight. Its statement is map_prod_swap applied to the pulled-back kernels. Its left side is `swapLeft` of a product. By `comap_prod`, that is the product of `swapLeft (prodMkRight α η)` and `swapLeft (prodMkLeft γ κ)`. These are definitionally `prodMkLeft α η` and `prodMkRight γ κ` (`swapLeft_prodMkRight`, `swapLeft_prodMkLeft`, both proved by `rfl`). Its right side is `prodMkLeft α η ×ₖ prodMkRight γ κ` by `map_prod_swap`. So the Fubini reasoning is proved twice, although `comap_prod` and `map_prod_swap` already give the result.
findings.proposed_change:
Keep map_prod_swap as the only lintegral/Fubini proof. Reprove comap_prod_swap from it and comap_prod, roughly:

lemma comap_prod_swap ... := by
  rw [map_prod_swap, comap_prod _ _ measurable_swap]
  rfl

Here `rfl`, or `simp [← swapLeft ...]`, closes `comap (prodMkRight α η) Prod.swap _ ×ₖ comap (prodMkLeft γ κ) Prod.swap _ = prodMkLeft α η ×ₖ prodMkRight γ κ`. This uses `swapLeft_prodMkRight` and `swapLeft_prodMkLeft`, which hold by `rfl`. The unchanged statement of comap_prod_swap would need to be placed after `comap_prod` and `map_prod_swap`. It already comes after `comap_prod` and only needs reordering after `map_prod_swap`.
findings.benefit: Removes a duplicated 13-line Fubini/swap proof. It makes explicit that comap_prod_swap is map_prod_swap combined with the comap_prod and swapLeft_prodMkLeft/swapLeft_prodMkRight API. Future changes to the integral lemmas (lintegral_prod, lintegral_lintegral_swap) then need updating in only one place. The unchanged statement keeps compatibility (no other uses of comap_prod_swap were found in the repository).
